name: index_arb_nifty_components_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: The NIFTY 50 index value computed from real-time component prices occasionally diverges from the NIFTY 50 futures fair value due to asynchronous component price updates, large single-stock block trades, and ETF creation/redemption lags. When the synthetic index (sum of weighted components) deviates from the futures-implied level by more than transaction costs, a mean-reversion trade exists. The inefficiency persists because full 50-stock replication is capital-intensive and execution across 50 legs is complex, but a basket of the top-10 weighted stocks (capturing ~55% of index weight) provides sufficient exposure. Retail cannot easily execute this; institutional desks do it but leave residual mispricing in the smaller components.
universe: NIFTY 50 top-10 by weight: RELIANCE, TCS, HDFCBANK, INFY, ICICIBANK, HINDUNILVR, ITC, SBIN, BHARTIARTL, KOTAKBANK
stock_filter: all components must have 1-min volume > 10000 shares
indicators: synthetic_index = sum(component_close[i] * weight[i] for i in top10) * scaling_factor

long.confirmation: basis_z upticks from trough (first bar where basis_z[t] > basis_z[t-1])

short.confirmation: basis_z downticks from peak (first bar where basis_z[t] < basis_z[t-1])

entry.entry_price: simultaneous limit orders across all 10 components, weight-proportional sizing

exit.stop_loss: basis_z exceeds 3.5 OR total basket loss > 0.3%
exit.trailing_stop: once basis_z crosses 0.5 toward zero, trail at 1.0 sigma
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 30 mins (mispricing should correct fast)
exit.signal_exit: if tracking_error spikes > 0.005 during trade, exit (basket no longer tracking)

risk.position_sizing: weight-proportional across 10 components; total notional = capital_per_trade

filters.vix_filter: none (trade in all VIX regimes, but increase z threshold to 2.5 if VIX > 20)
filters.volume_filter: all 10 components must have traded > 5000 shares in current 1-min bar
filters.event_filter: skip on NIFTY rebalancing days and F&O expiry days
other_filters: skip if any top-5 weight component is halted or has corporate action

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — as more algo desks implement this, basis dislocations shrink

weaknesses: 10-leg execution is complex; partial fills on any leg create unhedged exposure and tracking error against the index
The top-10 basket only captures ~55% of NIFTY weight, so basis calculations have inherent noise from the other 40 stocks
F&O expiry weeks cause basis to behave anomalously due to rollover dynamics, creating false signals
prior_art: Index arbitrage is well-documented (Brennan & Schwartz 1990, MacKinlay & Ramaswamy 1988). This is a simplified retail version using partial replication, inspired by Harris et al. (1995) on index arb profitability.
notes: Edge math: 0.65 * 30bps - 0.35 * 28bps = 19.5 - 9.8 = 9.7bps gross. With 10-leg execution costs higher (~15bps RT including slippage across all legs), net is thin. Edge of 20bps assumes 4-5 trades/day with compounding. Critical to have low-latency execution for all legs.
